en.title: Blessed Assurance
en.author: Fanny J. Crosby
stanzas:
[D]Blessed as[G]surance, [D]Jesus is mine!
Oh, what a [G]foretaste of [D]glory di[A]vine!
[D]Heir of sal[G]vation, [D]purchase of God,
Born of His [Em]Spirit, [A7]washed in His [D]blood.

Perfect submission, perfect delight,
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight;
Angels, descending, bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

Perfect submission, all is at rest,
I in my Savior am happy and blest,
Watching and waiting, looking above,
Filled with His goodness, lost in His love.
en.chorus:
[D]This is my [G]story, [D]this is my song,
Praising my Savior [E7]all the day [A]long;
[D]This is my [G]story, [D]this is my song,
[G]Praising my [D]Savior [A7]all the day [D]long.

notes: Three stanzas and refrain — the whole Crosby text; Timeless Truths and hymnary's representative text agree. Timeless Truths credits her formally as "Frances J. Crosby"; "Fanny J. Crosby" is used for consistency with her other entries in this set. Tune ASSURANCE (Phoebe P. Knapp, 1873); meter as hymnary lists it (Timeless Truths writes 9.10.9.9.9.9.9.9, counting the refrain's lines). Key: the common hymnal key is already D, one of the preferred guitar keys, so no transposition. Chords are Knapp's harmonization simplified; the refrain's first half-cadence keeps its V-of-V (E7) approach, and the second ends full on D as sung.
